crafts.help.title: Reference
crafts.help.cycle_text: One round of work. Its length is the work's base time: the profession's level cuts it by up to {0}% (fully at level {1}), and the speed of the tool and the tree divides the rest: +100% speed is twice as fast.
crafts.help.inputs_text: The work's materials plus one of each additive. They are spent at the start of every cycle, including one that comes out empty. Not enough for a cycle, and the work stops.
crafts.help.waste_text: The chance a cycle yields nothing: its cost is already spent and not returned, and it brings no output, no finds and no experience. Luck lowers this chance by its own percent of it, by {0}% at most: 20% wasted with +50% luck is 10%. The card shows the chance with your luck already in.
crafts.help.sure_text: The work has no empty cycles: every cycle brings output and experience.
crafts.help.yield_text: Extra output from the tool and the tree: every full 100% is one more unit per successful cycle, the rest is a chance at one more. When there is some, the card shows it in place of the wasted chance.
crafts.help.hour_text: The average output of an hour: the hour's cycles less the empty ones, times the extra output, doubling and tripling. It is an estimate — chance decides each cycle; finds are not in it.
crafts.help.experience_text: Profession experience for every successful cycle; an empty cycle gives none. The experience bonus adds its percent to it.
crafts.help.finds_text: Side items of the work: every successful cycle rolls each find on its own, one piece at a time. The profession's level raises the base chance by up to +{0}% (at level {1}), the find bonus by its own percent more; the chance never goes above 100%. The card shows it with your level and bonuses already in.
crafts.help.additives_text: Not every work takes additives: the smith does when forging a chosen group (not a random item), the quarry takes deadwood. Each additive is spent one per cycle on top of the cost — empty cycles included. A smith's additive guarantees the item its handcrafted line: the base is picked among those that can carry it, and another random handcrafted line may come by chance. Deadwood adds a stone to the quarry's output for every successful cycle.
crafts.help.tool_text: Every profession has its own tool slot; without a tool the work will not start. Its work lines give the work bonuses, and the tool's quality strengthens those lines by its percent. Branches of the skill tree give work bonuses too, and guild workshops give speed.
crafts.help.bonuses_text: Speed — a shorter cycle. Extra output — more units per cycle. Luck — wasted less often (by {0}% at most). Experience — more experience per cycle. Finds — finds more often. Doubling — a chance to double a cycle's output. Saving — a chance to get back a successful cycle's cost. Rarity — a chance that a crafted item, map, flask or jewel comes one step rarer: normal to magic, magic to rare. Item level — added to a crafted item's level. Unique — a percent added to the smith's unique chance.
crafts.help.level_text: Grows with the experience of cycles, each next level costs more; the cap is {0}. The level opens new works, cuts the cycle time (by up to −{1}% at the cap) and raises the find chance (by up to +{2}%), and for the smith also the unique chance and the crafted item's level.
crafts.help.away_text: The work goes on without you: cycles are counted on your next visit. {0} h after the last count without you the work stops — its plaque reads “stopped”, and “Resume” starts it again. There is no separate report of your absence: what was made is already in the bag, and the work's total is under “Since the work started”.

launch.tip.01: Volume up and down together open a bug report - from any screen, even over a menu.
launch.tip.02: While poison, bleeding or burning is on you, life does not recover on the map - only flasks heal.
launch.tip.03: Chaos damage goes past energy shield: against poison you need chaos resistance and a reserve of life.
launch.tip.04: A guardian sealed away? Hunt the map's rare monsters: once the seal breaks, the guardian drops a rare item.
launch.tip.05: Flasks on the belt are not for later: a sip in time is cheaper than death two steps from the guardian.
launch.tip.06: Atlas points come for deeds on the maps; an Atlas node works on every run that follows.
launch.tip.07: Crafts go on without you: a profession gathers while you are on a run or out of the game.
launch.tip.08: Tap a stat in the hero's summary to see what it is made of.
launch.tip.09: Might only estimates a hero's strength: a fight is decided by damage, defence and resistances, not one number.
launch.tip.10: Out of combat the hero rests and slowly recovers life - do not rush the guardian wounded.
launch.tip.11: A Vaal zone is more dangerous than a plain map, but its loot is richer.
launch.tip.12: Elemental resistance above the cap is wasted - put the surplus into life.
launch.tip.13: Boss trials are a ladder of their own: the higher the step, the bigger the reward.
launch.tip.14: A lock on an item keeps it from selling and from bulk picks.
launch.tip.15: The run menu holds the fight speed, all settings and the log of the last fight.
launch.tip.16: Stun and freeze interrupt a skill being used: no mana is spent.
launch.tip.17: Attack speed hastens strikes, cast speed - spells and curses; nothing hastens warcries and guards.
launch.tip.18: A hit that burns mana slows the cooldowns of a monster's skills.
launch.tip.19: «My reports» shows what became of your report: moderation, work and the developer's answer.
launch.tip.20: The stash can be expanded for gold once it grows cramped.
launch.lore.01: Nine thrones hold the world. An empty throne is a crack the land drains into.
launch.lore.02: The Grey Cloaks never name the guilt. Exile is the only sentence they know.
launch.lore.03: The sea by the island does not give up its drowned. It only returns them to the shore - later, and changed.
launch.lore.04: The exile ships sailed without lights, so no one could see where they were taken.
launch.lore.05: The brand surfaces in a single night. By morning the bearer no longer has the name they had.
launch.lore.06: The lighthouse keeper never left his post. Bones do not walk away.
launch.lore.07: The island's smugglers take no coin. What they do take, only those who paid know.
launch.lore.08: A seal does not hold forever. It only waits for its keeper to tire.
launch.lore.09: They say the world was once whole. No one on the island believes it.
launch.lore.10: The Rift opens once a week, and each time someone does not come back.
launch.lore.11: Corruption does not grow - it takes root: through stone, through bone, through memory.
launch.lore.12: The Vaal left behind not ruins, but hunger.
launch.lore.13: The Atlas is not a map of the world. It is a map of what is left of it.
launch.lore.14: The ship graveyard creaks its rigging even in a calm: the crews never came ashore.
launch.lore.15: Whoever once heard a voice from the water never sleeps easy by the sea again.
launch.lore.16: Every throne remembers all who sat on it. And all who never reached it.
launch.lore.17: Heirs are sought not by blood, but by dreams.
launch.lore.18: In the City of exiles no one asks what for. They ask - for how long.
launch.lore.19: Keepers age, seals weaken, and the change never comes of its own will.
launch.lore.20: Gold is taken on the island only because the dead have no use for it.

term.title: Terms
term.ARCANE_SURGE.text: A buff for a few seconds: faster spells and faster mana regeneration.
term.ONSLAUGHT.text: A buff for a few seconds: faster attacks and spells.
term.UNHOLY_MIGHT.text: A buff for a few seconds: part of the physical damage is added as chaos.
term.FORTIFY.text: A buff for a few seconds: less damage taken from hits.
term.FRENZY_CHARGE.text: Gathered up to a limit and wearing off in time; each speeds attacks up and adds damage.
term.POWER_CHARGE.text: Gathered up to a limit and wearing off in time; each raises the critical strike chance.
term.ENDURANCE_CHARGE.text: Gathered up to a limit and wearing off in time; each lowers physical damage taken and adds resistances.
term.IGNITE.text: A fire ailment: the target burns and loses life every second.
term.CHILL.text: A cold ailment: the target acts more slowly.
term.FREEZE.text: A cold ailment: the target cannot act until the ice is gone.
term.SHOCK.text: A lightning ailment: the target takes more damage.
term.ENERGY_SHIELD.text: Takes damage before life - in fights and from traps on the map - except chaos: chaos and poison go around the shield straight to life. It recharges once the hero goes unhurt for a while; every fight starts with a full shield.
term.shield.skills: • Skill damage over time - by the skill's damage type
term.CHAOS.text: Goes around energy shield straight to life; only chaos resistance reduces it. Poison deals chaos damage: it also goes around the shield, and chaos resistance reduces it.
term.CATALYST.text: An omen for the Orb of Quality: does nothing alone. An Orb of Quality used with it raises equipment quality (not flasks, maps or tools) by its rarity step, up to 20%, and the quality boosts the catalyst's kind of modifiers. Other quality is reset.
term.TIER.text: The strength step of a modifier: T1 is the strongest, the higher the number, the weaker. Strong tiers open with the item level; the line badge colour is the tier too: amber T1, mint T2, ice T3.
term.POISON.text: Poison deals chaos damage every second around energy shield, from the physical and chaos damage of a hit before the target's defences; chaos resistance cuts every tick. Only the strongest poison acts, more with «+N to Poison limit».
term.BLEED.text: A physical ailment: the target loses life every second.
term.WOUND.text: An ailment: while it lasts, the target's life regeneration and life leech are weaker by its effect.
term.PARCH.text: An ailment: while it lasts, the target's mana regeneration, mana leech and mana on hit are weaker by its effect.
term.DOT.text: Damage over time: poison, ignite, bleeding and the damage over time of skills. It does not grow hits.
term.HIT.text: Damage with hits: attacks, spells and the hits of powers. It does not grow poison, ignite, bleeding or skills' damage over time.
term.RECOVERY_SUPPRESSION.text: The hero's ignite, poison and bleeding cut the foe's regeneration and vampirism.
term.STUN.text: Heavy hits build a stun; a full bar interrupts the target for a while.
term.LOW_LIFE.text: A condition: life below {1}% of its maximum ({0}% for flasks and skill triggers).
term.CURSE.text: A hex of a skill for a time: the target is weaker while it lasts.
