Every {r:modifier.CONVERT_STRENGTH_TO_LIFE.effects.0.perAmount} strength gives +{r:classes.sharedLines.CONVERT_STRENGTH_TO_LIFE.values.0} life, every {r:modifier.CONVERT_STRENGTH_TO_PHYSICAL_DAMAGE.effects.0.perAmount} - +{r:classes.sharedLines.CONVERT_STRENGTH_TO_PHYSICAL_DAMAGE.values.0}% increased physical damage.
Always on: every hero's sheet counts it so. Each hero level adds +{r:classes.sharedPerLevel.STOCK_STRENGTH} strength.
Strength is a requirement of items and of strength skills' levels: while it falls short, the item is worn but does nothing and the skill level cannot be learned. Some unique powers grow with strength.
stat.detail.STOCK_AGILITY:
Every {r:modifier.CONVERT_DEXTERITY_TO_EVASION.effects.0.perAmount} dexterity gives +{r:classes.sharedLines.CONVERT_DEXTERITY_TO_EVASION.values.0}% increased evasion, every point - +{r:combat.accuracy.perDexterity} accuracy.
Always on: every hero's sheet counts it so. Each hero level adds +{r:classes.sharedPerLevel.STOCK_AGILITY} dexterity.
Dexterity is a requirement of items and of dexterity skills' levels: while it falls short, the item is worn but does nothing and the skill level cannot be learned. Accuracy decides how often you hit evasive foes.
stat.detail.STOCK_INTELLECT:
Every {r:modifier.CONVERT_INTELLIGENCE_TO_MANA.effects.0.perAmount} intelligence gives +{r:classes.sharedLines.CONVERT_INTELLIGENCE_TO_MANA.values.0} mana, every {r:modifier.CONVERT_INTELLIGENCE_TO_ENERGY_SHIELD.effects.0.perAmount} - +{r:classes.sharedLines.CONVERT_INTELLIGENCE_TO_ENERGY_SHIELD.values.0}% increased energy shield, every {r:modifier.CONVERT_INTELLIGENCE_TO_MANA_REGEN.effects.0.perAmount} - +{r:classes.sharedLines.CONVERT_INTELLIGENCE_TO_MANA_REGEN.values.0} mana regenerated per second.
Always on: every hero's sheet counts it so. Each hero level adds +{r:classes.sharedPerLevel.STOCK_INTELLECT} intelligence.
Intelligence is a requirement of items and of intelligence skills' levels: while it falls short, the item is worn but does nothing and the skill level cannot be learned. Base mana regeneration is {r:combat.mana.regen}% of the maximum per second, intelligence and items give the rest.
stat.detail.STOCK_ALL_ATTRIBUTES:
Adds to strength, dexterity and intelligence at once: «+10 to all attributes» is +10 to each of the three.
Always on. Each attribute gives its own: strength - life and physical damage, dexterity - evasion and accuracy, intelligence - mana, energy shield and mana regeneration.
It counts towards item and skill level requirements too.
stat.detail.STOCK_HEALTH:
How much damage you can take: at zero life you fall in the fight. Energy shield takes damage first, except chaos.
Every hero starts with {r:classes.sharedBase.STOCK_HEALTH} life and gains +{r:classes.sharedPerLevel.STOCK_HEALTH} per level; strength, items and the tree give more. Auras that hold life take their share of the maximum.
The maximum is what the regeneration share, low life ({r:lowLife}% for flasks and events, {r:passiveLowLife}% for passive skills' bonuses) and the leech limit per second are counted from. From level {r:combat.death.fromLevel}, dying costs {r:combat.death.experienceShare}% of the level's experience.
stat.detail.STOCK_MANA:
Your mana: skills spend it when used, and a skill cannot be used without it.
Every hero gains +{r:classes.sharedPerLevel.STOCK_MANA} mana per level; intelligence, items and the tree give more. Auras hold their share of mana: free mana is the maximum without it.
Base mana regeneration is {r:combat.mana.regen}% of the maximum per second; mana also comes back from regeneration given by intelligence and items, mana leech, mana on hit, kill and block, flasks and skills. «Mana before life» spends it like a shield.
stat.detail.STOCK_ENERGY_SHIELD:
Takes damage before life - any but chaos: hits, damage over time, reflection and traps.
{r:combat.shield.rechargeDelay} s after the last hit the shield recharges: {r:combat.shield.rechargePerSecond}% of its maximum per second, faster with «Shield Recharge», sooner with «Recharge Delay». Shield regeneration runs all the time.
Chaos and poison go past the shield straight to life. Works in fights and on the map.
stat.detail.STOCK_ARMOR:
Reduces the physical damage of hits: armour takes off «armour / (armour + {r:combat.armour.factor} × hit)» - more against weak hits, less against heavy ones.
Works in fights against the physical part of every hit, not damage over time. The sheet shows the reduction against a reference foe of your level together with «Physical Damage Reduction».
Armour and «Physical Damage Reduction» together stay under the physical reduction cap: {r:combat.ceilings.physical.base}%, raised up to {r:combat.ceilings.physical.hard}%. «Armour against Elements» lends part of your armour to elemental hits.
stat.detail.STOCK_EVASION:
A chance to dodge an attack entirely: the higher your evasion against the foe's accuracy, the more often the hit misses.
Works in fights against attacks only: spells, explosions and damage over time cannot be evaded, and a frozen hero never evades. The sheet shows the chance against a foe of your level.
The chance stays under the evasion cap: {r:combat.ceilings.evasion.base}%, raised up to {r:combat.ceilings.evasion.hard}%. Dexterity gives increased evasion.
stat.detail.STOCK_BLOCK_CHANCE:
A chance to block an attack hit - a blocked hit deals no damage.
Works in fights against attacks; spells are blocked by «Spell Block Chance». A frozen hero never blocks.
No higher than the block cap: {r:combat.ceilings.block.base}%, «Maximum Block» raises it up to {r:combat.ceilings.block.hard}%. A block grants life, mana and shield on block if you have them.
stat.detail.STOCK_STUN_THRESHOLD:
The higher the threshold, the slower stun builds: it adds to the size of your stun bar, which is your life.
Works in fights. A hit's physical damage fills the bar whole, the rest at {r:pct.combat.buildup.stunOther}%, a crit {r:combat.buildup.stunCrit} times more. A full bar stuns for {r:combat.buildup.stun.duration} s, then the bar is shut for {r:combat.buildup.immunity} s.
Without new hits the bar starts melting after {r:combat.buildup.decayDelay} s. «Stun Resistance» works beside it.
stat.detail.STOCK_SPELL_BLOCK:
A chance to block a spell hit - a blocked hit deals no damage.
Works in fights against spells; attacks are blocked by the usual «Chance to Block». A frozen hero never blocks.
No higher than the spell block cap: {r:combat.ceilings.spellBlock.base}%, «Maximum Spell Block» raises it up to {r:combat.ceilings.spellBlock.hard}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_PHYSICAL_REDUCTION:
This share of physical damage never reaches you - after armour.
Works in fights against the physical part of hits. Each endurance charge adds its own.
Together with armour it stays under the physical reduction cap: {r:combat.ceilings.physical.base}%, raised up to {r:combat.ceilings.physical.hard}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_AVOID_STUN:
This share of stun never reaches your bar: stun builds up more slowly.
Works in fights. No higher than 100% - then the bar never fills.
Its big brother is «Stun Immunity»; «Stun Threshold» grows the bar.
stat.detail.STOCK_RESIST_FIRE:
Reduces fire damage taken by this many percent - hits and ignite alike.
Works in fights. Under the cap of {r:combat.resistCap}%: «Maximum Fire Resistance» and «…Elemental Resistances» raise it, but not above {r:combat.resistHardCap}%. Resistance never drops below −{r:combat.resistFloor}%.
Campaign acts lower all resistances: by {r:combat.resistPenalty.1}% in the second act, more later on, by {r:combat.resistPenalty.5}% on maps. «All Resistances» add to fire; a foe's penetration takes part of it off.
stat.detail.STOCK_RESIST_COLD:
Reduces cold damage taken by this many percent.
Works in fights. Under the cap of {r:combat.resistCap}%: «Maximum Cold Resistance» and «…Elemental Resistances» raise it, but not above {r:combat.resistHardCap}%. Resistance never drops below −{r:combat.resistFloor}%.
Campaign acts lower all resistances: by {r:combat.resistPenalty.1}% in the second act, more later on, by {r:combat.resistPenalty.5}% on maps. «All Resistances» add to cold; a foe's penetration takes part of it off.
stat.detail.STOCK_RESIST_LIGHTNING:
Reduces lightning damage taken by this many percent.
Works in fights. Under the cap of {r:combat.resistCap}%: «Maximum Lightning Resistance» and «…Elemental Resistances» raise it, but not above {r:combat.resistHardCap}%. Resistance never drops below −{r:combat.resistFloor}%.
Campaign acts lower all resistances: by {r:combat.resistPenalty.1}% in the second act, more later on, by {r:combat.resistPenalty.5}% on maps. «All Resistances» add to lightning; a foe's penetration takes part of it off.
stat.detail.STOCK_RESIST_CHAOS:
Reduces chaos damage taken by this many percent - hits and poison alike.
Works in fights. Under the cap of {r:combat.resistCap}%: «Maximum Chaos Resistance» raises it, but not above {r:combat.resistHardCap}%. It never drops below −{r:combat.resistFloor}%.
Chaos is not an element: «…Elemental Resistances» do not touch it, «All Resistances» do. The act penalty ({r:combat.resistPenalty.5}% on maps) lowers it too. Chaos goes past energy shield.
stat.detail.STOCK_ALL_RESISTANCES:
Adds to every resistance: fire, cold, lightning and chaos.
Works in fights. Each resistance stays under its own cap.
Unlike elemental resistances, it touches chaos too.
stat.detail.STOCK_RESIST_MAX_FIRE:
Raises the fire resistance cap above its base of {r:combat.resistCap}%.
The cap cannot go above {r:combat.resistHardCap}%. Map lines may lower it.
Resistance gathered over the cap does nothing, but guards against penalties and reductions.
stat.detail.STOCK_RESIST_MAX_COLD:
Raises the cold resistance cap above its base of {r:combat.resistCap}%.
The cap cannot go above {r:combat.resistHardCap}%. Map lines may lower it.
Resistance gathered over the cap does nothing, but guards against penalties and reductions.
stat.detail.STOCK_RESIST_MAX_LIGHTNING:
Raises the lightning resistance cap above its base of {r:combat.resistCap}%.
The cap cannot go above {r:combat.resistHardCap}%. Map lines may lower it.
Resistance gathered over the cap does nothing, but guards against penalties and reductions.
stat.detail.STOCK_RESIST_MAX_CHAOS:
Raises the chaos resistance cap above its base of {r:combat.resistCap}%.
The cap cannot go above {r:combat.resistHardCap}%. Map lines may lower it.
Resistance gathered over the cap does nothing, but guards against penalties and reductions.
stat.detail.STOCK_RESIST_MAX_ALL:
Raises the caps of fire, cold and lightning resistances at once; chaos is left alone.
The caps cannot go above {r:combat.resistHardCap}%. Map lines may lower them.
stat.detail.STOCK_BLOCK_MAX:
Raises the attack block cap above its base of {r:combat.ceilings.block.base}%.
The cap cannot go above {r:combat.ceilings.block.hard}%.
Without block chance it gives nothing: the chance itself is «Chance to Block».
stat.detail.STOCK_SPELL_BLOCK_MAX:
Raises the spell block cap above its base of {r:combat.ceilings.spellBlock.base}%.
The cap cannot go above {r:combat.ceilings.spellBlock.hard}%.
Without spell block chance it gives nothing.
stat.detail.STOCK_EVASION_MAX:
Raises the evasion chance cap above its base of {r:combat.ceilings.evasion.base}%.
The cap cannot go above {r:combat.ceilings.evasion.hard}%.
The chance comes from evasion against the foe's accuracy.
stat.detail.STOCK_PHYSICAL_REDUCTION_MAX:
Raises the physical damage reduction cap (armour and «Physical Damage Reduction» together) above its base of {r:combat.ceilings.physical.base}%.
The cap cannot go above {r:combat.ceilings.physical.hard}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_ATTACK_PHYSICAL:
The physical damage of your hit - weapon, added damage and increases together. Every attack of yours deals it, and attack skills strike with their share of it.
Works in fights. With no damage on the sheet you fight bare-handed: {r:combat.unarmed.damage} physical damage.
The foe's armour and physical reduction work against it. A physical hit builds stun and may cause bleeding; «Physical as Extra …» lines add elements and chaos from part of it.
stat.detail.STOCK_ATTACK_MAGICAL:
Spell damage added in the spell's element; caster monsters count their hits so.
A hero's spell damage comes from the skills themselves, «Spell Damage» and «Added … Damage to Spells» lines.
stat.detail.STOCK_ATTACK_FIRE:
The fire damage of your hit - weapon, added damage and increases together. Every attack of yours deals it, attack skills with their share.
Works in fights. The foe's fire resistance works against it; your fire and elemental penetration take part of that off.
Fire ignites - with a chance to ignite; «Elemental Damage» increases it.
stat.detail.STOCK_ATTACK_COLD:
The cold damage of your hit - weapon, added damage and increases together. Every attack of yours deals it, attack skills with their share.
Works in fights. The foe's cold resistance works against it; your cold and elemental penetration take part of that off.
Cold chills the foe and builds their freeze bar; «Elemental Damage» increases it.
stat.detail.STOCK_ATTACK_LIGHTNING:
The lightning damage of your hit - weapon, added damage and increases together. Every attack of yours deals it, attack skills with their share.
Works in fights. The foe's lightning resistance works against it; your lightning and elemental penetration take part of that off.
Lightning shocks - with a chance to shock - and builds electrocute; «Elemental Damage» increases it.
stat.detail.STOCK_ATTACK_CHAOS:
The chaos damage of your hit - weapon, added damage and increases together. Every attack of yours deals it, attack skills with their share.
Works in fights. The foe's chaos resistance works against it, chaos penetration takes part of that off; energy shield does not hold chaos.
Chaos poisons - with a chance to poison - and lays Decay.
stat.detail.STOCK_ELEMENTAL_DAMAGE:
Increases fire, cold and lightning damage at once: hits and spells of those elements alike.
Works in fights and adds up with the increase of its own element.
Chaos and physical damage do not grow.
stat.detail.STOCK_DAMAGE:
All your damage as a percentage of normal: hits, spells, skills' damage over time and ailments counted from a hit. 100% is normal damage, 110% a tenth more.
Works in fights as a multiplier over every increase. Each frenzy charge adds its {r:rules.charges.kinds.FRENZY.lines.2.value}%; «more» and «less» damage lines multiply.
Map lines and altar pacts change it too.
stat.detail.STOCK_SKILL_DAMAGE:
Increases the damage of every skill: attack skills' hits, spells and skills' damage over time.
Works in fights and adds up with other damage increases. Plain weapon swings between skills do not grow.
For spells there is also «Spell Damage».
stat.detail.STOCK_SPELL_DAMAGE:
Increases the damage of spells and of spell skills' damage over time.
Works in fights and adds up with other spell increases: their element's, skill damage and general.
Attacks and weapon swings do not grow.
stat.detail.STOCK_CRITICAL_CHANCE:
The chance for an attack to become critical and hit for the critical multiplier. The base comes from your weapon, bare-handed - {r:combat.critical.chance}%; increases grow the base.
Works in fights for attacks and weapon swings; spells have their own chance. No higher than {r:combat.critical.chanceCap}%.
Power charges increase it, «Lucky Critical Strikes» rolls it twice.
stat.detail.STOCK_CRITICAL_MULTIPLIER_AL:
Adds to the critical multiplier of attacks and spells at once.
Works in fights. Each multiplier stays under its own cap of {r:combat.critical.cap}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_CRITICAL_MULTIPLIER:
An attack crit hits for this percentage of a normal hit: 150% is half again as strong. The base is {r:combat.critical.multiplier}%, additions sum with it. There is no separate crit damage.
Works in fights for attacks. The multiplier is no lower than 100% and no higher than {r:combat.critical.cap}%.
A foe's «Extra Critical Damage Taken» cuts the bonus over a normal hit; poison takes a share of it by «Critical Poison».
stat.detail.STOCK_CRITICAL_VAMPIRE:
This share of your critical strikes' damage comes back as life at once - on top of other leech.
Works in fights, times recovery rate and the life recovery share.
All leech together is no more than {r:combat.caps.leechPerSecond}% of maximum life per second.
stat.detail.STOCK_CRITICAL_TAKEN:
How much more or less extra damage critical strikes deal to you: only the crit's bonus over a normal hit changes.
Works in fights against foes' crits. It can be lowered by no more than {r:combat.caps.criticalTaken}%.
A foe's crit is still never weaker than a normal hit.
stat.detail.STOCK_SPELL_CRITICAL_CHANCE:
The chance for a spell to become critical and hit for the spell critical multiplier. The base comes from your weapon, bare-handed - {r:combat.critical.spellChance}%; increases grow the base.
Works in fights for spells; attack critical chance lines do nothing to spells. No higher than {r:combat.critical.chanceCap}%.
Power charges increase it too.
stat.detail.STOCK_SPELL_CRITICAL_MULTIPL:
A spell crit hits for this percentage of a normal hit. The base is {r:combat.critical.spellMultiplier}%, additions sum with it. There is no separate crit damage.
Works in fights for spells. The multiplier is no lower than 100% and no higher than {r:combat.critical.cap}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_PENETRATE_FIRE:
Your fire damage ignores this many percent of the target's fire resistance: it may go below zero.
Works in fights for hits and spells; it never pushes resistance below −{r:combat.resistFloor}%.
Adds up with «Elemental Penetration».
stat.detail.STOCK_PENETRATE_COLD:
Your cold damage ignores this many percent of the target's cold resistance: it may go below zero.
Works in fights for hits and spells; it never pushes resistance below −{r:combat.resistFloor}%.
Adds up with «Elemental Penetration».
stat.detail.STOCK_PENETRATE_LIGHTNING:
Your lightning damage ignores this many percent of the target's lightning resistance: it may go below zero.
Works in fights for hits and spells; it never pushes resistance below −{r:combat.resistFloor}%.
Adds up with «Elemental Penetration».
stat.detail.STOCK_PENETRATE_CHAOS:
Your chaos damage ignores this many percent of the target's chaos resistance: it may go below zero.
Works in fights for hits and spells; it never pushes resistance below −{r:combat.resistFloor}%.
Poison meets resistance on every tick without penetration.
stat.detail.STOCK_PENETRATE_ELEMENTAL:
Your fire, cold and lightning damage ignore this many percent of the target's resistance.
Works in fights for hits and spells and adds up with each element's own penetration. Resistance never goes below −{r:combat.resistFloor}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_DAMAGE_VS_AILED:
Your hits are stronger against a foe under any ailment - ignite, chill, freeze, shock, poison, bleeding, Wound or Parch.
Works in fights as a hit multiplier; the «Damage vs …» of every ailment on the target adds up with it. Decay and Essence Drain are not ailments.
Damage over time does not grow.
stat.detail.STOCK_DAMAGE_VS_BURNING:
Your hits are stronger against a burning foe.
Works in fights, adding up with «Damage vs Ailed» into one hit multiplier.
Damage over time does not grow.
stat.detail.STOCK_DAMAGE_VS_CHILLED:
Your hits are stronger against a chilled foe.
Works in fights, adding up with «Damage vs Ailed» into one hit multiplier.
Damage over time does not grow.
stat.detail.STOCK_DAMAGE_VS_SHOCKED:
Your hits are stronger against a shocked foe.
Works in fights, adding up with «Damage vs Ailed» into one hit multiplier; the shock itself also increases damage to the target.
Damage over time does not grow.
stat.detail.STOCK_DAMAGE_VS_POISONED:
Your hits are stronger against a poisoned foe.
Works in fights, adding up with «Damage vs Ailed» into one hit multiplier.
Damage over time does not grow.
stat.detail.STOCK_DAMAGE_VS_BLEEDING:
Your hits are stronger against a bleeding foe.
Works in fights, adding up with «Damage vs Ailed» into one hit multiplier.
Damage over time does not grow.
stat.detail.STOCK_ATTACK_SPEED:
How many weapon swings you make per second. It also speeds up using attack skills.
Works in fights. No fewer than {r:combat.attackSpeedMin} and no more than {r:combat.attackSpeedMax} swings per second; bare-handed - {r:combat.unarmed.speed}. Combat tempo: swings, skill use and cooldowns of the hero and monsters run at {r:pct.combat.tempo}% of the sheet's speed - the summary line already includes it.
Chill and foes' slows cut it; Onslaught, frenzy charges and warcries grow it.
stat.detail.STOCK_CAST_SPEED:
Spells and curses are cast faster: their cast time is divided by 1 + cast speed/100 together with «Skill Use Speed».
Works in fights. The speed-up is no more than +{r:combat.caps.castSpeed}% together with it; it does not shorten cooldowns - that is «Cooldown Recovery».
Frenzy charges, Onslaught and Arcane Surge add to it.
stat.detail.STOCK_MOVEMENT_SPEED:
How fast you walk across the map.
Works on the map. No faster than +{r:cap.STOCK_MOVEMENT_SPEED}% over a normal step and no slower than the lower limit.
Onslaught adds to it; map lines change it too.
stat.detail.STOCK_COOLDOWN_RECOVERY:
Every skill recovers faster: its cooldown is divided by 1 + value/100.
Works in fights for every skill. A cooldown is never shortened by more than {r:combat.caps.cooldownReduction}% of its base.
Chill, slows and the combat tempo ({r:pct.combat.tempo}% speed) stretch cooldowns; cast speed does not change them.
stat.detail.STOCK_SKILL_PREPARATION:
Attack, spell and curse skills are used faster - an addition to the using pace beside attack or cast speed.
Works in fights. The pace is no more than +{r:combat.caps.castSpeed}% together with the kind's speed.
Warcries, guards and heals take their own time.
stat.detail.STOCK_HEALTH_REGEN:
Life regenerated per second - the total as the fight counts it: flat regeneration and a share of the maximum, reduced regeneration, regeneration from mana, recovery rate, minus losses and degeneration.
Works in fights and on the map. Between fights on the map you also rest: {r:expedition.offCombatRegen}% of the maximum per second after {r:expedition.restDelay} s without damage taken; while bleeding, poisoned or burning there is neither regeneration nor rest on the map.
Reduced life regeneration, Wound and a ban on regeneration cut it, the floor holds it from below. The breakdown shows every step.
stat.detail.STOCK_MANA_REGEN_FLAT:
Mana regenerated per second - the total as the fight counts it: the base share of the maximum and flat regeneration times its increase and the mana recovery share.
Works in fights and on the map. Base regeneration is {r:combat.mana.regen}% of maximum mana per second, the rest comes from intelligence ({r:classes.sharedLines.CONVERT_INTELLIGENCE_TO_MANA_REGEN.values.0} per {r:modifier.CONVERT_INTELLIGENCE_TO_MANA_REGEN.effects.0.perAmount}), items, the tree, auras and Arcane Surge.
Reduced mana regeneration, Parch and map lines cut it; «No mana regeneration» stops it entirely.
stat.detail.STOCK_MANA_REGEN:
Increased mana regeneration: the base share of the maximum and flat regeneration together grow by this many percent - part of the «Mana Regeneration» figure.
Works in fights and on the map. The «reduced mana regeneration» map line and Arcane Surge sit here too.
Without flat mana regeneration it gives nothing.
stat.detail.STOCK_MANA_REGEN_TO_LIFE:
This share of your mana regeneration per second restores life as well, without spending mana.
It is life regeneration: the life recovery share (Wound, reduced regeneration) cuts it and recovery rate grows it.
Works in fights and on the map. Without mana regeneration it gives nothing.
stat.detail.STOCK_NO_MANA_REGEN:
Mana does not come back from regeneration, mana leech or mana on hit.
Mana on kill and on block, flasks and healing skills still restore it.
A high-tier map line and unique powers give it.
stat.detail.STOCK_ENERGY_REGEN:
Energy shield regenerated per second: flat regeneration and a share of the shield's maximum, times «Recovery Rate».
Runs all the time, in fights and on the map, even right after a hit - unlike the recharge, which waits for {r:combat.shield.rechargeDelay} s without damage.
The recovery share and ailments do not cut shield regeneration.
stat.detail.STOCK_LEECH_PHYSICAL:
This share of the physical damage of every hit and spell comes back as life at once.
Works in fights, times recovery rate and the life recovery share. All leech together is no more than {r:combat.caps.leechPerSecond}% of maximum life per second.
Reduced regeneration, Wound and a regeneration ban cut it; «Leech to Energy Shield» gives it to the shield.
stat.detail.STOCK_LEECH_MANA:
This share of all damage of every hit and spell comes back as mana.
Works in fights, times the mana recovery share: reduced mana regeneration, Parch and a mana regeneration ban cut it.
Mana leech has no limit per second.
stat.detail.STOCK_LEECH_ALL:
This share of all damage of every hit and spell comes back as life at once.
Works in fights, times recovery rate and the life recovery share. All leech together is no more than {r:combat.caps.leechPerSecond}% of maximum life per second.
Reduced regeneration, Wound and a regeneration ban cut it; «Leech to Energy Shield» gives it to the shield.
stat.detail.STOCK_HEALTH_ON_KILL:
Life for every kill: flat and a share of maximum life, times recovery rate.
Works in fights, for killing any foe.
Reduced regeneration and Wound do not cut it.
stat.detail.STOCK_MANA_ON_KILL:
Mana for every kill.
Works in fights, for killing any foe.
Reduced mana regeneration, Parch and a mana regeneration ban do not cut it.
stat.detail.STOCK_HEALTH_ON_HIT:
Life for every hit that lands, times recovery rate.
Works in fights: strikes and skills' attacks; spells and damage over time give no life.
Reduced regeneration and Wound do not cut it, and the leech limit per second does not apply.
stat.detail.STOCK_MANA_ON_HIT:
Mana for every hit that lands.
Works in fights: strikes and skills' attacks; spells and damage over time give no mana.
Reduced mana regeneration, Parch and a mana regeneration ban cut it.
stat.detail.STOCK_SKILL_COST:
Skills spend less mana: their cost falls by this many percent.
Works in fights for every skill. The reduction is no more than {r:combat.caps.skillCost}%; a negative value raises the cost without limit.
Map lines may raise skill costs.
stat.detail.STOCK_RESERVATION:
Auras hold a smaller share of the pool: an aura's share is divided by 1 + efficiency/100.
Works for every aura - of mana and of life. Auras hold no more than {r:combat.caps.reserve.MANA}% of mana and {r:combat.caps.reserve.LIFE}% of life, and the divisor is never less than {r:combat.floors.reserve}.
Free mana is the maximum without the auras' share; the mana breakdown shows what they hold.
stat.detail.STOCK_LIFE_REGEN_PERCENT:
This share of maximum life regenerates every second - part of the «Life Regeneration» figure.
Works in fights and on the map. It grows with maximum life; the life recovery share cuts it and recovery rate grows it, as with all regeneration.
The total per second is in «Life Regeneration».
stat.detail.STOCK_ENERGY_REGEN_PERCENT:
This share of maximum energy shield regenerates every second - part of the «Shield Regeneration» figure.
Works in fights and on the map, times «Recovery Rate», even right after a hit.
The total per second is in «Shield Regeneration».
stat.detail.STOCK_LIFE_DEGEN_PERCENT:
You lose this share of maximum life every second - past the energy shield, and it can kill.
In fights - no less than {r:combat.minDot} damage a tick. Between fights on the map degeneration never takes life below 1.
Regeneration, recovery rate and the recovery share do not cancel it: the regeneration figure has it subtracted.
stat.detail.STOCK_IGNITE_CHANCE:
A chance to ignite a foe with a hit carrying fire. A hero's own ignite chance is {r:combat.ailments.BURNING.heroChance}%; items, the tree and skills give it.
Ignite burns: over {r:combat.ailments.BURNING.duration} s it deals {r:combat.ailments.BURNING.magnitude}% of the hit's fire damage after the target's defences. A foe keeps its strongest ignite, and a new one refreshes the time.
Works in fights. «Burning Damage» and «Damage over Time» grow its damage, «Ignite Duration» its time.
stat.detail.STOCK_FREEZE_CHANCE:
Your hits build freeze faster: cold damage fills the foe's freeze bar - a share of its life - this many percent faster.
A full bar freezes for {r:combat.buildup.freeze.duration} s (a boss for {r:combat.buildup.freeze.bossDuration} s): the foe does nothing, and the first hit that shatters the ice is {r:combat.buildup.freeze.bonus}% stronger. Then the bar is shut for {r:combat.buildup.immunity} s.
Works in fights. «Freeze Duration» and «Ailment Duration» lengthen it.
stat.detail.STOCK_SHOCK_CHANCE:
A chance to shock a foe with a hit carrying lightning. A hero's own shock chance is {r:combat.ailments.SHOCKED.heroChance}%; items, the tree and skills give it.
A shocked foe takes {r:combat.ailments.SHOCKED.magnitude}% more damage for {r:combat.ailments.SHOCKED.duration} s - of every kind, from everyone.
Works in fights. «Effect of Shock» grows its strength, «Shock Duration» its time.
stat.detail.STOCK_POISON_CHANCE:
A chance to poison a foe with a hit carrying physical damage or chaos. A hero's own chance is {r:combat.ailments.POISONED.heroChance}%; items, the tree and skills give it.
Poison deals, as chaos over {r:combat.ailments.POISONED.duration} s, {r:combat.ailments.POISONED.magnitude}% of the hit's physical and chaos damage before the target's defences; on every tick the target's chaos resistance and «damage taken» cut it. Poisons stack, but only the strongest act: {r:combat.ailments.POISONED.limit} plus «Poison Limit».
Works in fights. A crit grows poison only by «Critical Poison».
stat.detail.STOCK_BLEED_CHANCE:
A chance to cause bleeding with a hit carrying physical damage. A hero's own chance is {r:combat.ailments.BLEEDING.heroChance}%; items, the tree and skills give it.
Bleeding deals {r:combat.ailments.BLEEDING.magnitude}% of the hit's physical damage after the target's defences over {r:combat.ailments.BLEEDING.duration} s. A foe keeps its strongest bleeding, and a new one refreshes the time.
Works in fights. «Bleeding Damage» and «Damage over Time» grow its damage.
stat.detail.STOCK_BURNING_DAMAGE:
Your ignite burns harder: its damage per second grows by this many percent.
Works in fights and adds up with «Damage over Time».
To burn sooner - «Faster Damaging Ailments».
stat.detail.STOCK_POISON_DAMAGE:
Your poison is stronger: each stack's damage grows by this many percent.
Works in fights and adds up with «Damage over Time».
stat.detail.STOCK_POISON_LIMIT:
How many more of your poisons act beside the strongest: every stack hangs on the foe, but only the {r:combat.ailments.POISONED.limit} strongest plus these tick.
Works in fights. No more than {r:combat.ailments.POISONED.most} act in all.
stat.detail.STOCK_POISON_CRITICAL:
This share of the critical multiplier's bonus lands on poison from a critical strike. Without it a crit does not grow poison.
Works in fights. No higher than {r:cap.STOCK_POISON_CRITICAL}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_DOT_DAMAGE:
Strengthens all your damage over time: poison, ignite, bleeding and skills' damage over time.
Works in fights and adds up with its ailment's own damage. Hits do not grow.
«Hit Damage» lines do nothing to it.
stat.detail.STOCK_HIT_DAMAGE:
Increases the damage of your hits - attacks and spells, beside other increases.
Works in fights. It does not grow ailments or damage over time.
For damage over time there is «Damage over Time».
stat.detail.STOCK_BLEED_DAMAGE:
Your bleeding is stronger: its damage per second grows by this many percent.
Works in fights and adds up with «Damage over Time».
stat.detail.STOCK_AVOID_IGNITE:
A chance not to be ignited by a foe's hit.
Works in fights. No higher than 100%; adds up with «Chance to Avoid Elemental Ailments».
To burn shorter - «Reduced Ignite Duration on You».
stat.detail.STOCK_AVOID_CHILL:
A chance not to be chilled by a foe's hit.
Works in fights. No higher than 100%; adds up with «Chance to Avoid Elemental Ailments».
Chill slows your swings and skill cooldowns.
stat.detail.STOCK_AVOID_FREEZE:
Freeze builds up on you more slowly: this share of cold never reaches your freeze bar.
Works in fights. No higher than 100%; adds up with «Chance to Avoid Elemental Ailments».
Frozen, you do nothing.
stat.detail.STOCK_AVOID_SHOCK:
A chance not to be shocked by a foe's hit.
Works in fights. No higher than 100%; adds up with «Chance to Avoid Elemental Ailments».
Shock on you means more damage taken.
stat.detail.STOCK_AVOID_POISON:
A chance not to be poisoned by a foe's hit.
Works in fights. No higher than 100%.
stat.detail.STOCK_AVOID_BLEED:
A chance not to start bleeding from a foe's hit.
Works in fights. No higher than 100%.
stat.detail.STOCK_AVOID_ELEMENTAL_AILMEN:
Adds to the chances to avoid ignite, chill and shock and to freeze resistance.
Works in fights. Each chance is no higher than 100%.
stat.detail.STOCK_IGNITE_DURATION_ON_SEL:
Ignite on you wears off sooner: its time is this many percent shorter - and it deals less damage.
Works in fights. No more than {r:combat.ailmentDurationCap}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_CHILL_DURATION_ON_SELF:
Chill on you wears off sooner: its time is this many percent shorter.
Works in fights. No more than {r:combat.ailmentDurationCap}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_FREEZE_DURATION_ON_SEL:
Freeze on you wears off sooner: its time is this many percent shorter.
Works in fights. No more than {r:combat.ailmentDurationCap}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_SHOCK_DURATION_ON_SELF:
Shock on you wears off sooner: its time is this many percent shorter.
Works in fights. No more than {r:combat.ailmentDurationCap}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_POISON_DURATION_ON_SEL:
Poison on you wears off sooner: its time is this many percent shorter - and it deals less damage.
Works in fights. No more than {r:combat.ailmentDurationCap}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_BLEED_DURATION_ON_SELF:
Bleeding on you wears off sooner: its time is this many percent shorter - and it deals less damage.
Works in fights. No more than {r:combat.ailmentDurationCap}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_GOLD:
More gold from foes, chests and finds of a run: gold grows by this many percent.
Works in runs: in fights for kills and in a map's rewards. Adds up with gold from the map, the Atlas and unique powers.
stat.detail.STOCK_EXPERIENCE:
More hero experience for kills and a run's rewards: experience grows by this many percent.
Works in runs. Adds up with experience from the Atlas and the map.
stat.detail.STOCK_RARITY:
Dropped items are more often magic and rare, and the unique chance grows: at {r:rules.loot.uniqueRarityHalf}% rarity it doubles, tripling at the limit.
Works for all of a run's loot: monsters, bosses, chests, trials. Adds up with rarity from the map, the Atlas, the guild and unique powers; negative rarity never cuts the unique chance.
The breakdown names unique powers «to uniques» and against certain foes separately.
stat.detail.STOCK_QUANTITY:
More items drop from foes and chests: every loot roll's chance grows by this many percent.
Works for a run's loot. Adds up with quantity from the map, the Atlas, risk and unique powers.
The breakdown names unique powers for maps and books separately.
stat.detail.STOCK_LIGHT_RADIUS:
How far you see on the map: the fog parts this far around the hero.
Works on the map. The biome multiplies the light; the result is no less than {r:expedition.minLight} and no more than {r:expedition.maxLight}.
Every hero starts with {r:classes.sharedBase.STOCK_LIGHT_RADIUS}.
stat.detail.STOCK_CHEST_QUANTITY:
More chests in zones: their number grows by this many percent.
Works on entering a zone; adds up with the Atlas's chests.
stat.detail.STOCK_PROVOKE:
A chance for your hit to provoke its main target for {r:combat.provoke.duration} s: it hits you softer and uses no skills - their cooldowns stand still.
A provoked foe hits softer by chance × {r:combat.provoke.damage}% (no more than {r:combat.provoke.damageCap}%); a boss by chance × {r:combat.provoke.bossDamage}% (no more than {r:combat.provoke.bossDamageCap}%), and it still uses skills but recovers them {r:combat.provoke.bossCooldownSlow} times slower.
The same target again no sooner than {r:combat.provoke.immunity} s later (a boss - {r:combat.provoke.bossImmunity} s). The chance is no higher than {r:cap.STOCK_PROVOKE}%; area hits, damage over time and ailments do not provoke.
stat.detail.STOCK_AILMENT_DURATION:
Your ailments last longer on foes: ignite, chill, freeze, shock, poison, bleeding, Wound and Parch.
Works in fights and adds up with its ailment's own duration: together no more than +{r:combat.caps.ailmentDuration}%. Longer damage over time means more damage.
It does not lengthen Decay or Essence Drain.
stat.detail.STOCK_IGNITE_DURATION:
Your ignite lasts longer on foes - and burns longer.
Works in fights; together with «Ailment Duration» no more than +{r:cap.STOCK_IGNITE_DURATION}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_CHILL_DURATION:
Your chill lasts longer on foes.
Works in fights; together with «Ailment Duration» no more than +{r:cap.STOCK_CHILL_DURATION}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_FREEZE_DURATION:
Your freeze lasts longer on foes.
Works in fights; together with «Ailment Duration» no more than +{r:cap.STOCK_FREEZE_DURATION}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_SHOCK_DURATION:
Your shock lasts longer on foes.
Works in fights; together with «Ailment Duration» no more than +{r:cap.STOCK_SHOCK_DURATION}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_POISON_DURATION:
Your poison lasts longer on foes - and deals more damage.
Works in fights; together with «Ailment Duration» no more than +{r:cap.STOCK_POISON_DURATION}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_BLEED_DURATION:
Your bleeding lasts longer on foes - and deals more damage.
Works in fights; together with «Ailment Duration» no more than +{r:cap.STOCK_BLEED_DURATION}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_DAMAGE_TAKEN:
How much more or less damage of every kind you take - hits and damage over time alike.
Works in fights. It multiplies with its own kind: «Physical Damage Taken», «Elemental…», «Chaos…».
However low it goes, damage never reaches zero. Foes' curses and auras raise it.
stat.detail.STOCK_PHYSICAL_TAKEN:
How much more or less physical damage you take.
Works in fights after armour: it multiplies with the general «Damage Taken». The «vulnerability» map line raises it.
However low it goes, damage never reaches zero.
stat.detail.STOCK_ELEMENTAL_TAKEN:
How much more or less fire, cold and lightning damage you take.
Works in fights after resistances: it multiplies with the general «Damage Taken».
However low it goes, damage never reaches zero.
stat.detail.STOCK_CHAOS_TAKEN:
How much more or less chaos damage you take - hits and poison alike.
Works in fights after chaos resistance: it multiplies with the general «Damage Taken».
«Chaos Immunity» removes chaos damage entirely.
stat.detail.STOCK_RECOVERY_RATE:
Speeds up everything that gives life and shield back: regeneration, leech, life on hit, on kill and on block, shield regeneration.
Works in fights and on the map. The «reduced recovery» map line lowers it.
It does not speed up flasks, healing skills or the shield's recharge.
stat.detail.STOCK_SHIELD_RECHARGE:
Energy shield recharge speed: after a pause without damage the shield refills {r:combat.shield.rechargePerSecond}% of its maximum per second, and that grows by this many percent.
Works in fights and on the map once {r:combat.shield.rechargeDelay} s have passed since the last hit.
When the recharge starts is up to «Recharge Delay».
stat.detail.STOCK_THORNS:
Physical damage to everyone who hits you with an attack.
Works in fights, for every hit that reaches you; spells do not wake thorns. The attacker's armour reduces it.
«Reflect» works beside it.
stat.detail.STOCK_REFLECT:
This share of the damage a hit dealt you goes back to the attacker - as the same damage types.
Works in fights against attacks only: spells and damage over time are not reflected. The attacker's armour and resistances reduce it.
«Thorns» work beside it.
stat.detail.STOCK_WORK_SPEED:
Profession cycles run faster: a cycle's length is divided by 1 + value/100.
Works for profession work - online and while you are away. The profession's tool and the guild tree add to it.
stat.detail.STOCK_WORK_YIELD:
Extra units gathered per work cycle: a share over the usual output.
Works for jobs that gather or make something. The profession's tool adds to it.
stat.detail.STOCK_WORK_LUCK:
A work cycle comes up empty less often: the job's «nothing» chance falls by this many percent.
No more than {r:crafts.luckCap}%. The profession's tool adds to it.
stat.detail.STOCK_WORK_EXPERIENCE:
More profession experience per work cycle: by this many percent.
Works for every job. Experience raises the profession's level - which speeds up cycles and brings finds more often.
stat.detail.STOCK_WORK_FIND:
Side finds turn up more often during work: each one's chance grows by this many percent.
No higher than 100%. The profession's level grows find chances too.
stat.detail.STOCK_SKILL_LEVEL:
Raises the level of all your skills by this many levels.
Works while the skill stands in a slot: additions for all skills, for its kind and for passives sum, but not above level {r:skills.boostedMaxLevel}.
The level grows the skill's numbers; added levels ask no attribute requirements.
stat.detail.STOCK_ATTACK_LEVEL:
Raises the level of all your attack skills.
Adds up with «Level of all Skills», not above level {r:skills.boostedMaxLevel}.
stat.detail.STOCK_SPELL_LEVEL:
Raises the level of all your spells.
Adds up with «Level of all Skills», not above level {r:skills.boostedMaxLevel}.
stat.detail.STOCK_WARCRY_LEVEL:
Raises the level of all your warcries.
Adds up with «Level of all Skills», not above level {r:skills.boostedMaxLevel}.
stat.detail.STOCK_CURSE_LEVEL:
Raises the level of all your curses.
Adds up with «Level of all Skills», not above level {r:skills.boostedMaxLevel}.
stat.detail.STOCK_AURA_LEVEL:
Raises the level of all your auras.
Adds up with «Level of all Skills» and «Level of Passives», not above level {r:skills.boostedMaxLevel}.
stat.detail.STOCK_PASSIVE_LEVEL:
Raises the level of passive skills: auras, bonuses and answers.
Adds up with «Level of all Skills», for auras also with «Level of Auras», not above level {r:skills.boostedMaxLevel}.
stat.detail.STOCK_AURA_EFFECT:
Your auras act stronger: their lines grow by this many percent.
Works while an aura stands in a passive skill slot. Life auras also get «Blood Aura Effect» on top.
The share of mana or life an aura holds does not grow.
stat.detail.STOCK_WARCRY_EFFECT:
Your warcries act stronger: their buff lines grow by this many percent.
Works in fights, for every warcry.
The buff's duration does not change.
stat.detail.STOCK_CURSE_EFFECT:
Your curses act stronger: their lines on the foe grow by this many percent.
Works in fights - for curse skills and for curses cast in answer to a hit.
stat.detail.STOCK_MARK_EFFECT:
Your marks store more damage: the share of damage a mark gathers and releases in its blast grows by this many percent.
Works in fights for skills with a mark.
stat.detail.STOCK_SKILL_HEALING:
Healing skills restore more life and mana: their healing is this many percent stronger.
Works in fights for active healing skills; it does not grow passive skills' answers or flasks.
Reduced regeneration and Wound do not cut a skill's healing.
stat.detail.STOCK_SKILL_TARGETS:
Attack skills that strike targets hit this many extra foes; fractions are dropped.
Works in fights. No more targets than foes on the field.
For spells - «Spell Targets».
stat.detail.STOCK_SPELL_TARGETS:
Spells that strike targets hit this many extra foes; fractions are dropped.
Works in fights. No more targets than foes on the field.
For attacks - «Skill Targets».
stat.detail.STOCK_FREE_SKILL_CHANCE:
A chance to use a skill without spending mana.
Works in fights for every use; the cooldown runs as usual.
Up to 100%.
stat.detail.STOCK_DAMAGE_VS_CURSED:
Your hits are stronger against a cursed foe - as a multiplier of its own.
Works in fights while the target is cursed.
Damage over time does not grow.
stat.detail.STOCK_CURSE_ON_HIT:
A chance to curse a foe that hit you: with the curse in your skill slots, or a curse of your class without one.
Works in fights, for every hit that reaches you.
The curse's strength is its level and «Curse Effect».
stat.detail.STOCK_WARCRY_SPEED:
Each warcry also grants this many percent increased attack speed - for the length of its buff.
Works in fights while the warcry's buff lasts.
stat.detail.STOCK_WARCRY_HEAL:
Every warcry restores this share of maximum life - bit by bit over its buff; a warcry without a buff heals at once.
Works in fights. A warcry at full life heals the damage that comes during that time.
stat.detail.STOCK_FLASK_CHARGES_GAINED:
Flasks gain more charges per kill: the base ({r:combat.flasks.perKill.NORMAL} for a normal foe, {r:combat.flasks.perKill.MAGIC} - magic, {r:combat.flasks.perKill.RARE} - rare, {r:combat.flasks.perKill.UNIQUE} - unique) grows by this many percent.
Works in fights. A map line may lower flask charges.
stat.detail.STOCK_FLASK_DURATION:
Flask effects last longer: a sip's duration grows by this many percent together with the flask's own increase.
Works in fights. A duration is never shorter than {r:rules.flasks.minDuration} s.
stat.detail.STOCK_FLASK_DURATION_MORE:
A multiplier of every flask's duration on top of its increases: +20 is a fifth longer.
Works in fights. Brief flasks are not lengthened by it.
stat.detail.STOCK_FLASK_EFFECT:
The lines flasks lay on the hero for a sip act this many percent stronger.
Works in fights. Flask healing is «Flask Recovery». A map line may lower flask effect.
stat.detail.STOCK_FLASK_CHARGES_USED:
A sip spends fewer charges: the flask's cost falls by this many percent together with its own saving.
Works in fights.
stat.detail.STOCK_FLASK_LIFE_RECOVERY:
Life flasks heal this many percent more - on top of «Flask Recovery».
Works in fights for life flasks only.
stat.detail.STOCK_FLASK_RECOVERY:
Life and mana flasks restore this many percent more.
Works in fights. Reduced regeneration and Wound do not cut flask healing.
stat.detail.STOCK_FLASK_CHARGES_PER_KILL:
This many charges over the usual each flask gains per kill.
Works in fights for every flask on the belt. Increased flask charges do not grow it.
stat.detail.STOCK_IMMUNE_BLEED:
Bleeding never lands on you.
Works in fights. The physical damage of the hits themselves does not change.
stat.detail.STOCK_IMMUNE_FREEZE:
You cannot be frozen or chilled: the freeze bar never fills.
Works in fights.
stat.detail.STOCK_IMMUNE_IGNITE:
Ignite never lands on you.
Works in fights. A fire hit still hurts - fire resistance meets it.
stat.detail.STOCK_IMMUNE_SHOCK:
Shock never lands on you.
Works in fights. Foes' shock adds no damage to you.
stat.detail.STOCK_IMMUNE_POISON:
Poison never lands on you.
Works in fights. Chaos hits still hurt - chaos resistance meets them.
stat.detail.STOCK_IMMUNE_CURSE:
Foes' curses never land on you.
Works in fights.
stat.detail.STOCK_IMMUNE_STUN:
You cannot be stunned: the stun bar never fills.
Works in fights.
stat.detail.STOCK_CHAOS_IMMUNE:
Chaos damage and poison do not harm you at all.
Works in fights, against every chaos hit and damage over time.
Chaos resistance is no longer needed.
stat.detail.STOCK_MAX_FRENZY_CHARGES:
How many frenzy charges you hold: the rules' base of {r:rules.charges.maximum} plus items and nodes. Each charge: +{r:rules.charges.kinds.FRENZY.lines.0.value}% increased attack speed, +{r:rules.charges.kinds.FRENZY.lines.1.value}% cast speed and {r:rules.charges.kinds.FRENZY.lines.2.value}% more damage of every kind.
Only gathering skills, skill runes and powers give charges; they never appear by themselves. A charge lives {r:rules.charges.duration} s («Charge Duration» longer), and a new one refreshes every frenzy charge.
Charges do not vanish after a fight: the time left melts on the map, and you enter the run's next fight with them. Spending skills take every charge of their kind and hit harder for each; «Damage per Frenzy Charge» adds damage for each.
stat.detail.STOCK_MAX_POWER_CHARGES:
How many power charges you hold: the rules' base of {r:rules.charges.maximum} plus items and nodes. Each charge: +{r:rules.charges.kinds.POWER.lines.0.value}% increased attack critical chance and +{r:rules.charges.kinds.POWER.lines.1.value}% - spell critical chance.
Only gathering skills, skill runes and powers give charges; they never appear by themselves. A charge lives {r:rules.charges.duration} s («Charge Duration» longer), and a new one refreshes every power charge.
Charges do not vanish after a fight: the time left melts on the map, and you enter the run's next fight with them. Spending skills take every charge of their kind and hit harder for each; «Damage per Power Charge» adds damage for each.
stat.detail.STOCK_MAX_ENDURANCE_CHARGES:
How many endurance charges you hold: the rules' base of {r:rules.charges.maximum} plus items and nodes. Each charge: +{r:rules.charges.kinds.ENDURANCE.lines.0.value}% physical damage reduction and +{r:rules.charges.kinds.ENDURANCE.lines.1.value}% to all elemental resistances.
Only gathering skills, skill runes and powers give charges; they never appear by themselves. A charge lives {r:rules.charges.duration} s («Charge Duration» longer), and a new one refreshes every endurance charge.
Charges do not vanish after a fight: the time left melts on the map, and you enter the run's next fight with them. Spending skills take every charge of their kind and hit harder for each; «Damage per Endurance Charge» adds damage for each.
stat.detail.STOCK_CHARGE_DURATION:
Frenzy, power and endurance charges live longer: the {r:rules.charges.duration} s grow by this many percent.
A new charge of a kind refreshes every charge of that kind - the longer they live, the easier they stay full.
The time left melts on the map between fights too.
stat.detail.STOCK_LIFE_DAMAGE_DELAYED:
This share of damage to life does not land at once but in equal parts over the delay ({r:combat.lifeDelay} s unless items set their own).
Works in fights: a hit meets barrier, shield and «mana before life» first, and the rest is delayed.
Delayed damage still lands and can kill; in a fight it buys time for regeneration and flasks. No higher than 100%.
stat.detail.STOCK_LIFE_DAMAGE_DELAY:
Over how many seconds delayed life damage lands.
Without this line it is {r:combat.lifeDelay} s.
«Delayed Life Damage» sets the delayed share.
stat.detail.STOCK_PHYSICAL_TAKEN_AS_FIRE:
This share of the physical damage of hits on you arrives as fire - fire resistance meets it, not armour.
Works in fights. If the elements' shares together pass 100%, they split the physical damage by their shares.
Pays off with high fire resistance.
stat.detail.STOCK_PHYSICAL_TAKEN_AS_COLD:
This share of the physical damage of hits on you arrives as cold - cold resistance meets it, not armour.
Works in fights. If the elements' shares together pass 100%, they split the physical damage by their shares.
Pays off with high cold resistance.
stat.detail.STOCK_PHYSICAL_TAKEN_AS_LIGH:
This share of the physical damage of hits on you arrives as lightning - lightning resistance meets it, not armour.
Works in fights. If the elements' shares together pass 100%, they split the physical damage by their shares.
Pays off with high lightning resistance.
stat.detail.STOCK_RANDOM_ELEMENT_HITS:
All the damage of each of your hits becomes one random element: fire, cold or lightning.
Works in fights for hits and spells. The target's resistance to that element meets it, and the element's natural ailment follows.
Pays off against foes weak to at least one element.
stat.detail.STOCK_HIGHEST_RESIST_TAKEN:
Fire, cold and lightning damage meet your highest elemental resistance instead of their own.
Works in fights. Chaos is not an element: its own resistance meets it.
Pays off when one elemental resistance is far above the rest.
stat.detail.STOCK_HIGHEST_RESIST_ELEMENT:
How much more or less damage you take from the element you resist most.
Works in fights; the element is chosen by your resistances at the moment of the hit.
stat.detail.STOCK_LOWEST_RESIST_PENETRAT:
Your damage of the element the target resists least penetrates it by this many more percent.
Works in fights and adds up with other penetration.
stat.detail.STOCK_IGNITE_AS_CHAOS:
Your ignites deal chaos damage instead of fire: the target's chaos resistance meets them, and energy shield does not hold them.
Works in fights. Ignite chance and strength stay the same.
stat.detail.STOCK_MANA_BEFORE_LIFE:
This share of the damage bound for life is taken from mana first - while there is mana.
Works in fights after barrier and energy shield. No higher than 100%.
Mana spent this way is not there for skills: mind your mana regeneration.
stat.detail.STOCK_LEECH_TO_SHIELD:
Life leech restores energy shield instead of life.
Works in fights; the leech limit per second is the same. Life on hit still goes to life.
stat.detail.STOCK_SHIELD_DEGEN_PERCENT:
You lose this share of maximum energy shield every second.
Works in fights. Shield recharge and regeneration run on top.
stat.detail.STOCK_FLASKS_AUTO:
Every flask on the belt is drunk at the fight's start for no charges.
Works in fights, every fight. Except a sip that would go to waste.
stat.detail.STOCK_LUCKY_CRIT:
Critical chance is rolled twice, and a lucky roll counts.
Works in fights for attacks and spells; the critical chance cap stays the same.
stat.detail.STOCK_NON_CRIT_DAMAGE:
The damage of your non-critical hits as a multiplier: −40 is 40% less.
Works in fights. Crits are left alone.
stat.detail.STOCK_ACCURACY:
Decides how often your attacks hit evasive foes: the higher your accuracy against their evasion, the better the chance. The chance to hit is never below {r:pct.combat.accuracy.minHit}%.
The base is {r:combat.accuracy.base} plus {r:combat.accuracy.perLevel} per hero level, plus {r:combat.accuracy.perDexterity} per point of dexterity; accuracy increases grow all of it.
Works in fights for attacks; spells cannot be evaded.
stat.detail.STOCK_PHYSICAL_AS_EXTRA_FIRE:
A hit adds fire damage equal to this share of its physical damage; the physical damage stays.
Works in fights for hits. The added fire meets fire resistance and may ignite.
stat.detail.STOCK_PHYSICAL_AS_EXTRA_COLD:
A hit adds cold damage equal to this share of its physical damage; the physical damage stays.
Works in fights for hits. The added cold meets cold resistance and chills.
stat.detail.STOCK_PHYSICAL_AS_EXTRA_LIGH:
A hit adds lightning damage equal to this share of its physical damage; the physical damage stays.
Works in fights for hits. The added lightning meets lightning resistance and may shock.
stat.detail.STOCK_PHYSICAL_AS_EXTRA_CHAO:
A hit adds chaos damage equal to this share of its physical damage; the physical damage stays.
Works in fights for hits. Unholy Might gives +{r:combat.buffs.unholyMight.lines.0.value}% to it. Chaos goes past the foe's energy shield.
stat.detail.STOCK_SPELL_ADD_FIRE:
Fire damage added to each of your spells - on top of the skill's own damage.
Works in fights. Grows with fire and spell increases.
stat.detail.STOCK_SPELL_ADD_COLD:
Cold damage added to each of your spells - on top of the skill's own damage.
Works in fights. Grows with cold and spell increases.
stat.detail.STOCK_SPELL_ADD_LIGHTNING:
Lightning damage added to each of your spells - on top of the skill's own damage.
Works in fights. Grows with lightning and spell increases.
stat.detail.STOCK_DOUBLE_DAMAGE:
A chance for a hit to deal double damage.
Works in fights for hits and spells. No higher than {r:cap.STOCK_DOUBLE_DAMAGE}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_CULLING:
Your hit instantly finishes a foe left with less than this share of life.
Works in fights. No higher than {r:combat.caps.culling}%, and against a boss or a unique foe no higher than {r:combat.caps.bossCulling}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_DAMAGE_PER_FRENZY:
Your damage is increased by this many percent for each frenzy charge you hold.
Works in fights beside other increases. Without charges it gives nothing.
stat.detail.STOCK_DAMAGE_PER_POWER:
Your damage is increased by this many percent for each power charge you hold.
Works in fights beside other increases. Without charges it gives nothing.
stat.detail.STOCK_DAMAGE_PER_ENDURANCE:
Your damage is increased by this many percent for each endurance charge you hold.
Works in fights beside other increases. Without charges it gives nothing.
stat.detail.STOCK_SHOCK_EFFECT:
Your shock increases damage to the foe more: its {r:combat.ailments.SHOCKED.magnitude}% grow by this many percent.
Works in fights.
stat.detail.STOCK_CHILL_EFFECT:
Your chill slows the foe more: its {r:combat.ailments.CHILLED.magnitude}% grow by this many percent.
Works in fights. A chilled foe swings and recovers skills more slowly.
stat.detail.STOCK_FASTER_AILMENTS:
Your ignite, poison and bleeding from hits deal their damage faster: the same damage in a shorter time.
Works in fights.
stat.detail.STOCK_ONSLAUGHT_ON_KILL:
A chance to gain Onslaught on kill: +{r:combat.buffs.onslaught.lines.0.value}% increased attack speed, +{r:combat.buffs.onslaught.lines.1.value}% cast speed and +{r:combat.buffs.onslaught.lines.2.value}% movement speed for {r:combat.buffs.onslaught.duration} s.
Works in fights. A new Onslaught refreshes its time; «Buff Duration» lengthens it.
stat.detail.STOCK_UNHOLY_MIGHT_ON_KILL:
A chance to gain Unholy Might on kill: hits add chaos equal to {r:combat.buffs.unholyMight.lines.0.value}% of their physical damage for {r:combat.buffs.unholyMight.duration} s.
Works in fights. A new Unholy Might refreshes its time; «Buff Duration» lengthens it.
stat.detail.STOCK_ARCANE_SURGE_ON_KILL:
A chance to gain Arcane Surge on kill: +{r:combat.buffs.arcaneSurge.lines.0.value}% cast speed and +{r:combat.buffs.arcaneSurge.lines.1.value}% increased mana regeneration for {r:combat.buffs.arcaneSurge.duration} s.
Works in fights. A new Arcane Surge refreshes its time; «Buff Duration» lengthens it.
stat.detail.STOCK_FORTIFY_ON_HIT:
A chance to gain Fortify with every hit that lands: {r:combat.buffs.fortify.lines.0.value}% hit damage taken for {r:combat.buffs.fortify.duration} s.
Works in fights: strikes and skills' attacks, not spells. A new Fortify refreshes its time.
«Buff Duration» lengthens it.
stat.detail.STOCK_ONSLAUGHT_ALWAYS:
Onslaught at all times from the fight's start, at {r:combat.buffs.onslaught.always}% of its strength: faster attacks, spells and steps.
Works in fights, the whole fight. Lines «while under Onslaught» act in full.
stat.detail.STOCK_UNHOLY_MIGHT_ALWAYS:
Unholy Might at all times from the fight's start, at {r:combat.buffs.unholyMight.always}% of its strength: hits add chaos from physical damage.
Works in fights, the whole fight.
stat.detail.STOCK_ARCANE_SURGE_ALWAYS:
Arcane Surge at all times from the fight's start, at {r:combat.buffs.arcaneSurge.always}% of its strength: faster spells and stronger mana regeneration.
Works in fights, the whole fight.
stat.detail.STOCK_FORTIFY_ALWAYS:
Fortified at all times from the fight's start: you take less hit damage - Fortify acts at {r:combat.buffs.fortify.always}% of its strength ({r:combat.buffs.fortify.lines.0.value}% hit damage taken at full).
Works in fights, the whole fight. Lines «while Fortified» act in full.
Fortify does not cut damage over time.
stat.detail.STOCK_BUFF_DURATION:
Onslaught, Unholy Might, Arcane Surge and Fortify last this many percent longer.
Works in fights. Skills' buffs - warcries and blessings - are not lengthened. A map line may shorten the time, but never below {r:pct.combat.floors.buffDuration}% of normal.
stat.detail.STOCK_HIT_TAKEN:
How much more or less damage you take from hits; damage over time does not change.
Works in fights. Fortify lowers it.
However low it goes, damage never reaches zero.
stat.detail.STOCK_SPELL_SUPPRESSION:
A chance to suppress a spell that hits you: a suppressed spell deals {r:combat.defence.suppressed}% less damage.
Works in fights against spells. The chance is no higher than {r:combat.defence.suppressionCap}%.
«Deflection» does the same for attacks.
stat.detail.STOCK_DEFLECTION:
A chance to deflect an attack that hits you: a deflected attack deals {r:combat.defence.deflected}% less damage.
Works in fights against attacks. The chance is no higher than {r:combat.defence.deflectionCap}%.
«Spell Suppression» does the same for spells.
stat.detail.STOCK_HEALTH_ON_BLOCK:
Life for every block - of an attack or a spell, times recovery rate.
Works in fights, only when you block a hit.
Depends on your block and spell block chances.
stat.detail.STOCK_MANA_ON_BLOCK:
Mana for every block - of an attack or a spell.
Works in fights, only when you block a hit. A mana regeneration ban does not cut it.
Depends on your block and spell block chances.
stat.detail.STOCK_SHIELD_ON_BLOCK:
Energy shield for every block - of an attack or a spell, up to the shield's maximum.
Works in fights, only when you block a hit.
Depends on your block and spell block chances.
stat.detail.STOCK_HEALTH_ON_KILL_PERCENT:
This share of maximum life comes back for every kill - part of the «Life on Kill» figure.
Works in fights, times recovery rate.
The total per kill is in «Life on Kill».
stat.detail.STOCK_SHIELD_ON_KILL:
Energy shield for every kill, up to the shield's maximum.
Works in fights, for killing any foe.
stat.detail.STOCK_LIFE_RECOUP:
This share of damage taken comes back as life - in equal parts over {r:combat.defence.recoup} s.
Works in fights, from hit damage that got past your defences. No more than {r:cap.STOCK_LIFE_RECOUP}%.
The recovery share and recovery rate do not change it.
stat.detail.STOCK_ARMOUR_ELEMENTAL:
This share of your armour also guards against fire, cold and lightning damage - by the same formula as against physical.
Works in fights against the elemental part of hits, together with resistances. No higher than 100%.
Without armour it gives nothing.
stat.detail.STOCK_SHIELD_RECHARGE_START:
Energy shield starts recharging sooner: the {r:combat.shield.rechargeDelay} s delay after a hit is divided by 1 + value/100.
Works in fights and on the map.
The recharge speed itself is «Shield Recharge».
stat.detail.STOCK_WORK_DOUBLE:
A chance for a work cycle to give double output.
Works for jobs that gather or make something.
stat.detail.STOCK_WORK_SAVE:
A chance for a work cycle to use no materials.
Works for jobs with materials.
stat.detail.STOCK_WORK_RARITY:
A chance for a crafted item, map, flask or jewel to come out one rarity higher: normal - magic, magic - rare.
Rare and higher do not rise.
stat.detail.STOCK_WORK_ITEM_LEVEL:
Adds to the item level of crafted items: a higher level means stronger lines and base.
Works for jobs that make items.
stat.detail.STOCK_WORK_UNIQUE:
Raises the chance to forge a unique item at the smith - by this many percent.
Works for smithing jobs.
stat.detail.STOCK_STUN_BUILDUP:
Your hits build stun on a foe faster - a share of its life by rarity, physical damage whole, the rest at {r:pct.combat.buildup.stunOther}%.
A full bar stuns for {r:combat.buildup.stun.duration} s (a boss for {r:combat.buildup.stun.bossDuration} s), and a stunned foe takes {r:combat.buildup.stun.bonus}% more damage.
Works in fights. Then the bar is shut for {r:combat.buildup.immunity} s.
stat.detail.STOCK_ELECTROCUTE_BUILDUP:
Your hits build electrocute faster: lightning damage fills the foe's bar this many percent faster.
A full bar holds the foe for {r:combat.buildup.electrocute.duration} s (a boss for {r:combat.buildup.electrocute.bossDuration} s), and it takes {r:combat.buildup.electrocute.bonus}% more lightning damage.
Works in fights. Then the bar is shut for {r:combat.buildup.immunity} s.
stat.detail.STOCK_BLIGHT_REDUCTION:
Blight monsters hit you this many percent softer.
Works in fights only against the map's blighted monsters. No higher than 100%.
stat.detail.STOCK_RECOVERY_SUPPRESSION:
While your ignite, poison or bleeding is on a foe, its regeneration and leech are weaker: a base of {r:rules.fight.suppression.base}% plus this value, no more than {r:rules.fight.suppression.cap}%.
Works in fights. The foe's resistance to suppression cuts it.
stat.detail.STOCK_SKILL_EXPERIENCE:
Skills in slots gain experience faster: their share of fight experience grows by this many percent.
Works in runs. Experience raises skill levels.
stat.detail.STOCK_RUNE_EFFECT:
Runes in your skills act stronger: a rune's numbers grow by this many percent.
Works for every rune in a skill's open sockets.
The rune in the last open socket also grows by «Last Rune Power».
stat.detail.STOCK_LAST_RUNE_EFFECT:
The rune in a skill's last open socket acts this many percent stronger - on top of «Rune Effect».
Works for every skill with runes.
stat.detail.STOCK_ASCENDED_DAMAGE:
Skills of the ascended tier hit harder: their hit carries this damage bonus.
Works only for skills raised by the ritual to the ascended tier.
stat.detail.STOCK_ACTIVE_RUNE_SOCKETS:
Active skills get this many extra rune sockets beyond their tier's.
Works for every active skill; runes in the new sockets act at once.
stat.detail.STOCK_PASSIVE_TIER:
Passive skills act this many tiers higher: a tier gives them more rune sockets and stronger numbers.
Works for every passive skill, no higher than the last tier.
stat.detail.STOCK_FATE_EFFECT:
Strengthens your Fate gift: the numbers of its actions grow by this many percent, whole numbers only in whole steps, and a chance no higher than 100%.
Counted from the sheet without the gift itself: items, the tree and the Atlas give it, not the gift's own lines. The gift's sheet lines grow too and round towards their number.
Works wherever the gift does: in fights and on the map.
stat.detail.STOCK_WOUND_CHANCE:
A chance to wound a foe with a hit. A Wound cuts its life regeneration and leech by {r:combat.ailments.WOUNDED.magnitude}% for {r:combat.ailments.WOUNDED.duration} s.
Works in fights. A foe carries one Wound, the strongest; its strength is no higher than {r:combat.ailments.WOUNDED.ceiling}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_AVOID_WOUND:
A chance not to be wounded by a foe's hit.
Works in fights. No higher than 100%.
A Wound cuts your life regeneration and leech.
stat.detail.STOCK_WOUND_DURATION:
Your Wound lasts longer on foes.
Works in fights; together with «Ailment Duration» no more than +{r:cap.STOCK_WOUND_DURATION}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_WOUND_EFFECT:
Your Wound cuts the foe's life recovery more: its {r:combat.ailments.WOUNDED.magnitude}% grow by this many percent.
Works in fights. Its strength is no higher than {r:combat.ailments.WOUNDED.ceiling}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_WOUND_TAKEN:
How much harder a Wound cuts your life recovery.
Works in fights and on the map, where a Wound came with you from a fight. Its strength is no higher than {r:combat.ailments.WOUNDED.ceiling}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_IMMUNE_WOUND:
A Wound never lands on you.
Works in fights.
stat.detail.STOCK_PARCH_CHANCE:
A chance to parch a foe with a hit. Parch cuts its mana regeneration, mana leech and mana on hit by {r:combat.ailments.PARCHED.magnitude}% for {r:combat.ailments.PARCHED.duration} s.
Works in fights. A foe carries one Parch, the strongest; its strength is no higher than {r:combat.ailments.PARCHED.ceiling}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_AVOID_PARCH:
A chance not to be parched by a foe's hit.
Works in fights. No higher than 100%.
Parch cuts your mana regeneration, mana leech and mana on hit.
stat.detail.STOCK_PARCH_DURATION:
Your Parch lasts longer on foes.
Works in fights; together with «Ailment Duration» no more than +{r:cap.STOCK_PARCH_DURATION}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_PARCH_EFFECT:
Your Parch cuts the foe's mana recovery more: its {r:combat.ailments.PARCHED.magnitude}% grow by this many percent.
Works in fights. Its strength is no higher than {r:combat.ailments.PARCHED.ceiling}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_PARCH_TAKEN:
How much harder Parch cuts your mana recovery.
Works in fights and on the map, where Parch came with you from a fight. Its strength is no higher than {r:combat.ailments.PARCHED.ceiling}%.
stat.detail.STOCK_IMMUNE_PARCH:
Parch never lands on you.
Works in fights.
stat.detail.STOCK_DAMAGE_VS_WOUNDED:
Your hits are stronger against a wounded foe.
Works in fights, adding up with «Damage vs Ailed» into one hit multiplier.
Damage over time does not grow.
stat.detail.STOCK_DAMAGE_VS_PARCHED:
Your hits are stronger against a parched foe.
Works in fights, adding up with «Damage vs Ailed» into one hit multiplier.
Damage over time does not grow.
stat.detail.STOCK_LIFE_REGEN_LESS:
How much weaker your life regeneration and leech are, in percent.
Additions sum, together no more than 100%; the life recovery floor stops the cut below itself. Wound cuts on top.
Does not touch flasks, healing skills, life on kill or on hit. Map lines and foes' curses give it.
stat.detail.STOCK_MANA_REGEN_LESS:
How much weaker your mana regeneration, mana leech and mana on hit are, in percent.
Additions sum, together no more than 100%. Parch cuts on top.
Does not touch flasks, skills, mana on kill or on block. Foes' curses give it.
stat.detail.STOCK_NO_LIFE_REGEN:
Life does not come back from regeneration or leech.
Flasks, fountains and healing skills still heal. The life recovery floor keeps its share even under the ban.
Map lines and Rift foes give it.
stat.detail.STOCK_LIFE_REGEN_FLOOR:
Below this share nothing cuts your life regeneration and leech: not reduced regeneration, not Wound, not even a regeneration ban.
Works in fights and on the map.
No higher than 100%.
stat.detail.STOCK_DECAY_EFFECT:
Each stack of your Decay is stronger: its +{r:combat.ailments.DECAYED.magnitude}% chaos damage taken grows by this many percent.
Every chaos hit of yours lays Decay; a stack lives {r:combat.ailments.DECAYED.duration} s, and a new one refreshes them all.
Works in fights: it grows chaos hits and poison ticks alike.
stat.detail.STOCK_DECAY_LIMIT:
How many more stacks of your Decay act over the rules' limit of {r:combat.ailments.DECAYED.limit}.
Works in fights; the weakest extra stacks fall off.
stat.detail.STOCK_DRAIN_DURATION:
Essence Drain lasts this many percent longer - and deals more damage: its ticks run longer.
Works in fights for that skill. No more than +{r:cap.STOCK_DRAIN_DURATION}%; the general «Ailment Duration» does not add to it.
stat.detail.STOCK_LIFE_RESERVATION:
Life auras hold a smaller share of life: this adds to the general reservation efficiency.
Life auras hold no more than {r:combat.caps.reserve.LIFE}% of maximum life.
The held life is taken off the maximum.
stat.detail.STOCK_BLOOD_AURA_EFFECT:
Auras that hold a share of life act stronger - on top of the general aura effect.
Works while a life aura stands in a passive skill slot.
The share of life the aura holds does not grow from it.

term.lore.SEAL.text: Nine thrones, nine seals. While someone sits on a throne, its land does not crumble into nothing. There is no other "seal" in the world.
term.lore.THRONE.text: No one remembers who raised the thrones. A throne cannot be abandoned — only passed on.
term.lore.KEEPER.text: The one who sits on a throne. Keepers grow old, the seals weaken and seek a successor.
term.lore.HEIR.text: The one the seals "hear". Dreams of water haunt him, and a voice calling a name that is not his.
term.lore.BRAND.text: The heir's mark, rising on the skin overnight. The true reason for every exile, whatever the sentence says.
term.lore.GREY_CLOAKS.text: The order that has ferried heirs to the island for centuries. To them exile is a rite, not a punishment.
term.lore.LAW.text: The gift of a taken throne: one of two, forever. The price — monsters beyond the throne and on the Atlas grow stronger.
term.lore.LINE.text: All your heroes are one line of exiles. Fate is the line's destiny: a gift all its heroes carry.
term.lore.ARCHITECT.text: The forgotten builder of the thrones — order itself. His influence settles on items and maps like a blueprint.
term.lore.VOID.text: What lies beyond the seals: not darkness but decay without colour or shape. The Void's influence eats things from within.
term.lore.ABYSS.text: The bottom of the chasm, where everything falls — and an endless hunger. The sixth throne stands at its bottom, and Abyss cracks open on Atlas maps as well.
term.lore.UNDERSIDE.text: The breaches beyond the seals through which the Lord of the Rift left. An item touched by the Underside sets in corruption — no orb takes it any more. The breach guardians still keep watch.
term.lore.RIFT.text: The Lord of the Rift broke the sky and stepped beyond the seals. After the last throne he tests the world every week — that is the weekly Rift.
term.lore.ECHO.text: What remains of the thrones the Lord of the Rift stole. In the Rift they are paid with.
term.lore.BLIGHT.text: The plague from the Rotten Heart in the Abyssal Depths. When the Abyss's seal passed to the heir, the seeds of the Blight scattered across the Atlas, and the Mother of Blight sprouts there as an offshoot of the Rotheart.
term.lore.ATLAS.text: Not new lands but the same ones, let go by the seals. Without a seal a land remembers itself less well, and the higher a map's tier, the more it has forgotten.
term.lore.ESSENCE.text: A seal's voice locked in a crystal, from whispering to deafening. An essence crystal on a map holds such a voice — that is why crystals sing.
term.lore.EMPIRE.text: One empire: its legions reached the jungle, its church raised inquisitors. The emperor flooded it himself to save the eighth throne.
term.lore.MYTHIC.text: The belongings of earlier candidates: those who reached the Halls and never sat each left one behind.
